title: 401(k)之父推新退休计划：雇主出资，员工应急可提
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us now is financial expert and co-creator of radish Ted Bennett.
segments.zh: 现在加入我们的是金融专家、Radish联合创始人泰德·贝内特。

segments.en: Ted explained to us what this is about.
segments.zh: 泰德向我们解释了这项计划的内容。

segments.en: And what did you see as the inherent problem with the current state of the 401K?
segments.zh: 您认为当前401K计划存在哪些根本问题？

segments.en: Well, the problem by Christina is it's reached a point now where many middle and low-income employees can't afford to have money taking out their paycheck.
segments.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，问题在于，现在许多中低收入员工负担不起从工资中扣除这笔钱。

segments.en: And you know, with cost of living, you know, housing, you know, education, medical care, food, et cetera, even when they have the opportunity,
segments.zh: 而且，考虑到生活成本，比如住房、教育、医疗、食品等，即使有机会，他们也负担不起。

segments.en: they just can't afford to do it. So, you know, I came up with this new plan, you know, it was a way to help middle and low-income employees
segments.zh: 所以我提出了这个新计划，旨在帮助中低收入员工，因为它完全由雇主出资。

segments.en: And you're rather than being a plan that's intended to help, you know, 20, 30 years from now, employees can have access to it when they have financial need.
segments.zh: 而且，这个计划不是为二三十年后准备的，员工在遇到财务需求时就可以使用。

segments.en: So, if they need $500 or $1,000 to repair a car to be able to get to work or for medical expenses
segments.zh: 比如，他们需要500或1000美元修车以便上班，或用于医疗费用。

segments.en: of other significant financial needs, you know, they can dip into it and take money to provide for those type of needs.
segments.zh: 或其他重大财务需求，他们可以动用这笔钱来满足这些需求。

segments.en: I mean, that makes sense because, you know, I've been through phases of my life where I thought it really made more sense for me to have a liquidity rather than put it in my 401K
segments.zh: 这很合理，因为在我人生的某些阶段，我觉得持有流动性资产比投入401K更合适，因为当时有账单要付，也有不确定性。

segments.en: because there were bills, there were uncertainties. So, there's no penalty when you need to take those funds out?
segments.zh: 那么，当你需要取出这些资金时，不会有罚款吗？
